rules: disk: L rings of 32 and one centre; radial j <-> j and ring L <-> centre, unit strength; unit exterior tie; no exterior lateral penalty; no local potential; interior lateral energy 1/2 u_l^T K u_l on rings 2..L

arms: selective K = tau B^T B, B = (C - e_1 I)(C - e_8 I), tau = 1 / min q_k over k not in {1,8,24,31}; no_lateral K = 0; ordinary_smoothing K = C; wrong_bands as selective with modes 1, 4 (excluded {1,4,28,31})
grid: arms x L in {2, 4} x alpha in {0.5, 1}; 20 replicates; primary selective L = 4 alpha = 1
settling: v1 L-BFGS-B from u = 0 and Newton polish; certified iff max|grad| < 1e-8 and min Hessian eigenvalue > 1e-8; every canonical state within 1e-7 (inf-norm) of the Cholesky direct solve

nuisance: v1 Fourier basis, N(0,1) coefficients from default_rng([20261030, 0, r]) shape (2,4,50,32), rescaled per draw to RMS alpha/sqrt(2); same draws for every arm, depth and alpha; draws 0-24 train, 25-49 test

readout: absolute sigma = 0.1 times eps from default_rng([20261030, 1, r, l, family]) shape (4,50,32), l 1-based, family 0 = F-low, 1 = F-high; v1 nearest_mean on all 32 coordinates, means from certified noisy training states
pure signal: 4 drives per family and configuration, canonical start; Vsig(l) = mean_{c,j} (u - mean_d u)^2

criteria per family: T1 S(1) >= S(l); T2 P(L)/P(1) <= 0.25; T3 strict NM at layer L >= 0.9; T4 J_n <= 0.5, J_n = [P(L)/P(1)] / [Vsig(L)/Vsig(1)], unavailable (T4 not met) if a pure-signal drive is unsettled or P(1), Vsig(1) or Vsig(L) < 1e-12; replicate eligible iff all 400 canonical settlings certified
replicate success: eligible and T1-T4 in both families; primary success iff >= 18 of 20; Clopper-Pearson 95%

gates: Hessian symmetric PD; lateral coupling distance per arm; radial/centre structure; derivatives by central differences step 1e-6 with |fd - analytic| <= 1e-5 max(1, max|analytic|) and the quadratic energy identity to 1e-12 relative; spatial versus tridiagonal transfer 1e-9; gains in [0, 1] and nonincreasing inward to 1e-10; pure-signal responses equal declared gains to 1e-9; NM equals an independent vectorized implementation
parallel over (configuration, replicate) units with one BLAS thread per process; results do not depend on worker count; reported floats rounded to 10 significant digits
